title: Author detection: a strict version that returns nothing when they named no source
Power-tagging: only fires when they named a source in the same sentence as the absolute word
Power-tagging: challenge what they actually said instead of inventing which card it was
Power-tagging: phrase it as a challenge the judge can check, not a claim about a card we never saw
find: return `Judge, compare the evidence rigor between the two teams: our opponents overstated their ${safeAuthor} card as a 100 percent certainty when the underlying study only describes a conditional scenario. Reward our side's disciplined, accurately qualified citations over exaggerated power-tags.`;
replace: return `Judge, compare how carefully each side tags its evidence. They used their ${safeAuthor} card to support ${word ? `an absolute claim — they said "${word}"` : "an absolute claim"}. I am asking them to read the line from that card that states it in those terms; if the study only describes a conditional scenario, the tag is doing work the evidence does not. Prefer the side whose tags match its cards.`;
